name: Walk on Water
source:
"I could write a whole thesis on men." Glenn McQueen is the CEO and star of New York's biggest GV company. This strong and mysterious man, who even straight men would be attracted to, keeps trying to pull you into his world. When an actor can't make it due to an unfortunate accident, McQueen immediately makes you his co-star.

[From in-app]
translation:
“我可以写一篇关于男人的论文。” Glenn McQueen是纽约最大的GV公司的首席执行官和明星。这个连直男都会被吸引的坚强而神秘的男人，一直试图把你拉进他的世界。当一名演员因不幸事故而无法上场时，麦昆会立即让你成为他的搭档。

[来自应用程序内]
